t: Haek yehe hilluko beshabbat, ubeezeh meqomot lo yelek, ubeezeh kelim o chapatzim yelek ubeezeh lo yelek, veim nishru kelayv
s: Hashlama litchillat hassimman haek yehe hilluko beshabbat, ubeezeh meqomot lo yelek, ubeezeh kelim o chapatzim yelek ubeezeh lo yelek, veim nishru kelayv: a. "Im tashib mishshabbat ragleka veku', vekibbadto measot derakeka vego'", shello yehe hillukeka beshabbat kehillukeka bechol. Lepikak, asur larutz beshabbat, o leqappetz, dehaynu laaqor shette raglayv bebat achat, o ledalleg, dehaynu laaqor raglo hashsheniyya qodem sheyyanniach harishona, o lipsoa pesia gassa, dehaynu kol sheyyesh bah yoter meamma merosh gudal regel zo ad rosh gudal regel hashsheniyya im epshar lo bepachot, dehaynu sheen sham repesh vetit o ammat hammayim, kemo sheyyitbaer. Veap bechol en lipsoa pesia gassa, mippene shennotelet achat mechamesh meot mimmeor enayv shel adam: b. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beholek lidbar hareshut, abal im (chaser) : ad kan matzanu: beezeh kelim muttar latzet beshabbat ubeezeh mehem asurim ubo s"g seipim: ap al pi shenneemar battora setam "lo taaseh kol melaka", velo nitparesh bah ezeh asiyya niqret melaka veezeh asiyya enah niqret melaka, umitztzad hassebara shehahotzaa vehahaknasa mereshut lirshut enah niqret beshem melaka kelal, ap al pi ken mimmah shessomka tora parashat shabbat limleket hammishkan lilmod sheen meleket hammishkan docha et hashshabbat, mikkan anu lomedim shekkol melaka shehayeta chashuba bammishkan niqret melaka leinyan shabbat, vehahotzaa hayeta gam ken melaka chashuba bammishkan, shenneemar "ish veishsha al yaasu od melaka litrumat haqqodesh vayyikkale haam mehabi", ha lamadta shehahabaa shehayu mebiin mibbetam shehu reshut hayyachid el mosheh haomed bemachaneh leviyya shehi reshut harabbim — niqret habaa zo melaka. Uminyan kol hammelakot shehayu bammishkan hen l"t, vehen niqraot "abot melakot", sheyyesh od toladot, shellamedu mippi hashshemua shello otan hammelakot bilbad shehayu bammishkan niqreu melakot, ella kol melaka haddoma limlaka shehayeta bammishkan hi niqret gam ken beshem melaka kemotah, vahare hi biklal "lo taaseh kol melaka", kegon haknasa mereshut harabbim lirshut hayyachid hi toledet hahotzaa mereshut hayyachid lirshut harabbim (shehi doma lah mammash[)]. Vaapillu kol melaka haddoma bemiqtzat limlaka shehayeta bammishkan — hare hi toladtah, ap al pi sheenah doma lah mammash, kegon hattochen hu ab melaka shehayeta bammishkan bishchiqat samemane hatztzeba, vehamchattek hayyaraq daq daq hu toledet hattochen, shehattochen loqeach gup echad umechalleqo legupim daqqim harbeh, vekol haoseh dabar haddomeh lazeh hi toledet hattochen, ap al pi sheenah doma lo legamre, shehattochen meshanneh et gup harishon legamre, mah sheen ken hamchattek, ap al pi ken hoil vedomeh lo beheasotah gupim rabbim miggup echad — hare zo toladto. Veken yesh bishar kol hammelakot. (Umittok hatztzaa zo yitbaer leka taam kol haddebarim sheameru alehem shehem asurim beshabbat min hattora, kemo sheyyitbaer kol echad veechad bimqomo):

Kol hammelakot kullan enan asurin beshabbat min hattora ella laasotan beshabbat kedarkan sheoseh otan bechol, abal im oseh otan beshinnuy midderek hachol, sheen derek bechol leolam laasotan ken melaka zo — patur min hattora. Abal asur laasot ken middibre soperim, shemma yabo laasotah kedarkah bechol. Ketzad? Kegon shehotzi chepetz leachar yado, o beraglayv, o bepiv, o ben atztzile yadayv, o beminalo, vekol kayyotze bazeh sheenan derek lehotzi ken bechol — hare zeh patur, abal asur. Veokelin shehotzian bepiv — chayyab, shezzeh gam ken derek hotzaatan bechol. Vekol dabar eno chayyab alayv ella im ken hotzio derek massoy, abal im hotzian derek malbush shellebasho vehotzio, o apillu lo lebasho ella telao bemalbushayv letakshit, o shettelao beeched meebarayv letakshit, ap al pi shedderek lehotzio ken bechol — patur min hattora. Veyesh mehem debarim shemmuttarim apillu middibre soperim. Veyesh mehem debarim sheasurim middibre soperim leishsha velo leish, vehem kol takshit sheepshar lah lesholpah mimmenna leharot noyah lachabertah kederek hannashim. Veyesh debarim sheasurim ap leish, vehem kol takshit shehu rapuy alayv, sheepshar lo beqal lippol mealayv meelayv, ukemo sheyyitbaer:

Vekol dabar sheochazo beyado vehotzio — chayyab alayv bekol inyan, ap al pi shehu takshit o malbush shedderek lelobsho o lehitqashshet bo beechad meebarayv, mikkol maqom derek hu gam ken lehotzio beyado lipamim. Veyesh debarim sheapillu lo achazan beyado ella telaan bemalbushayv o beeched meebarayv — chayyab alehem im derek lehotzian ken bechol lipamim, kegon ish hayyotze besayip hachagura lo bemotnayv, o beqeshet o bemagen o beromach hatteluyin alayv bemaqom shedderek litlotan sham bechol lipamim — hare zeh chayyab, kevan shehotzian kederek hotzaatan bechol, vehen enan lo malbush velo takshit, sheim hayu takshit lo hayu betelin leatid labo, shenneemar "vekittetu charbotam leittim vego'". Abal im yatza labush beshiryon, o bekoba shel barzel, o beanpelaot shel barzel haasuyot lemilchama, hoil vehen derek malbush — hare zeh patur, abal asur middibre soperim, mishshum shennireh keyotze lemilchama beshabbat. Veken im yatza labush bitpillin — patur, abal asur middibre soperim, apillu im hu beinyan sheen issur bilbishatan mishshum "bal tosip", kegon sheeno mitkavven leshem mitzvat tepillin, kemo shennitbaer besimman k"t vel"a, mikkol maqom asur latzet bahen middibre soperim, gezera shemma yitztarek likkanes lebet hakkisse visiren mealayv veyishkach vibien beyado d' ammot birshut harabbim, o mereshut harabbim lirshut hayyachid kede lehatznian. Veken lo yetze adam qatan beminal shehu gadol mimmiddat raglayv, shemma yippol meal raglo veyishkach vibiennu beyado. Abal yotze hu bechaluq gadol, sheen lachush shemma yippol mealayv. Veken lo yetze adam beminal echad beraglo achat veraglo hashshenit beli minal, ki shemma yischaqu alayv al sheholek beminal echad visirennu meal raglo veyishkach vibiennu beyado. Veim yesh lo makka beraglo hashsheniyya shei epshar lo linol bah minal — muttar lo latzet beminal shebberaglo haachat sheen bah makka, sheen lachush shemma yischaqu alayv, lepi shemmakkato mokachat alayv shei epshar lo linol bah (vekol issurim shennitbaaru vesheyyitbaaru besimman zeh, im asurim gam ken bechatzer ubabbayit — yitbaer besimman sh"g):

Lo yetze adam, ben ish ben ishsha, bemachat, ben nequba ben sheenah nequba, hattechuba lo bebigdo beotan meqomot shebbebigdo sheen derek leolam letochobah sham bechol, ap al pi sheen zeh hotzaa kedarkah, mikkol maqom asur middibre soperim. Abal ish sheyyatza bemachat hannequba hattechuba lo bebigdo lechabber qetzotayv, kegon mapteche chaluqo, vekayyotze bazeh mehammeqomot shebbebigdo shedderek litchob sham machat bechol, ap al pi shehi letzorek hallebisha — chayyab chattat, lepi sheen derek litchob sham machat hannequba ella machat sheenah nequba, vezeh shettachab machat nequba — massoy hu lo, ap al pi shehi tzerika lo lilbishato, sheen adam rashshay latzet im kol chapatzim hatztzerikim lo kesheenan lo takshit velo derek malbush. (Veen zo niqret hotzaa shello kedarkah, lepi shellipamim bechol kesherotzeh leholik machat hannequba leezeh maqom tochabah lipamim bebigdo behammeqomot shettochabin machat sheenah nequba umolikah kak birshut harabbim ad hammaqom shehu chapetz), ulepikak hare zo hotzaa kedarkah vechayyab aleha. Vekol shekken im enah techuba lo letzorek lebishato, raq techuba behammeqomot shebbebigdo shedderek litchob bahem machat bechol lipamim keshemmolikah leezeh maqom:

Abal machat sheenah nequba hattechuba bebigdo apillu bimqomot shedderek litchob bahem bechol — patur, mippene shemmachat zo hoil vedarkah leshammesh beotan hammeqomot shebbabbeged letzorek hallebisha — hare hi kebet yad leotan meqomot, vetorat malbush aleha. Umikkol maqom, middibre soperim asur latzet bah, mippene sheroshah haab sheeno naqub yesh alayv torat takshit, veyesh lachush shemma yishlepennu mibbigdo leharot noyah laacherim veyishkach vibiennu beyado. Veap im en alayv torat takshit kelal — en lehaqel, lepi sheyyesh choleqim veomerim sheish hayyotze bemachat sheenah nequba hattechuba bebigdo letzorek hallebisha — hare zeh chayyab. (Veap lepi sebara harishona en lehattir bemachat sheenah nequba sheen aleha torat takshit kelal ella bizman shedderek haanashim litchob machat sheenah nequba bebigdehem letzorek hallebisha, shennaaset machat zo lahem kebet yad lebigdehem, hoil vedarkah leshammesh letzorek lebishatam. Abal bizman sheen darkam bekak, im hi techuba beshabbat bemaqom shedderek letochobah bo bechol lipamim kesherotzeh leholikah leezeh maqom — chayyab, veim lav — patur, abal asur middibre soperim kishar kol hotzaa shello kedarka bechol). Vekol zeh beish, abal din haishsha bemachat hannequba vesheenah nequba — yitbaer besimman sh"g:

Tabbaat sheyyesh aleha chotam hi mittakshite haish velo mittakshite haishsha, vetabbaat sheen aleha chotam hi mittakshite haishsha velo mittakshite haish. Ulepikak, haish sheyyatza betabbaat sheen aleha chotam shebbeetzbao — chayyab, shemmassoy hu lo, veen zo hotzaa shello kedarkah, lepi shellipamim notenet ishsha lebalah tabbatah sheen aleha chotam sheyyolikenna lauman letaqqenah vehu mesim otah beetzbao ad shemmaggia etzel uman, nimtza shedderek hotzaa hi ap leish lipamim lehotzi tabbaat sheen aleha chotam beetzbao, vekevan sheenah takshit lo — chayyab aleha. Abal im yatza betabbaat sheyyesh aleha chotam shehu takshit lo — patur, abal asur middibre soperim, gezera shemma yishlepenna meetzbao leharot noyah laacherim veachar kak yishkach vibienna beyado. Veyesh omerim shello gazeru gezera zo ella benashim, lepi shehen shachatzaniyyot vedarkan bekak leharot noy takshitehen zo lezo, abal ish eno shachatz veen darko bekak, velaken muttar lo latzet betabbaat sheyyesh aleha chotam shehi takshit lo, veken bishar takshitayv, veap al pi sheenam mechubbarim liksuto sheepshar lo lesholpam velittelam beyado leharotam laacherim — en chosheshin lezeh, hoil veen darko bekak. Veken iqqar. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemine takshitin haddomin letabbaat sheyyesh aleha chotam shehi takshit leish velo leishsha, veken kol mine takshitin shehem takshitin leish velo leishsha, sheen derek haishsha lehitqashshet bahem kelal, abal mine takshitim shehem takshit leish uleishsha, sheggam hannashim darkan lehitqashshet betakshitin hallalu, kegon machat sheenah nequba lepi sebara harishona shennitbaer lemala, vekol kayyotze bah — hare hem asurim ap laanashim ledibre hakkol, kede shello lechalleq beissur min takshit echad ben anashim lenashim. (Ulepikak, ap bizman hazzeh shennahagu haanashim lehitqashshet bechol ap betabbaat sheen aleha chotam, vahare hu akshav lahem takshit velo massoy — ap al pi ken asurim latzet bah beshabbat, hoil vehu takshit gam ken lenashim. Ulepi zeh ap betabbaat sheyyesh aleha chotam en latzet bizman hazzeh, shehannashim nahagu gam ken lehitqashshet ap betabbaat sheyyesh alehen chotam, vahare hen takshit leish uleishsha. Ella sheakshav nahagu hetter anashim venashim bekol hattabbaot, veen limchot beyadam, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"g, ayyen sham hattaam[)]:

Tabbaat sheqqabua bah eben chalaqa, o apillu ketubin bah otiyyot al haeben o al hattabbaat — en zeh niqra chotam, shello niqra chotam ella im ken chaquqim bah otiyyot o tzurot, kede sheim yachtemuha al hashshaava yihyu al hashshaava otiyyot o tzurot boletot, veken im boletin bah otiyyot o tzurot sheim yachtemenna al hashshaava yihyu al hashshaava otiyyot o tzurot shoqeot, kol zeh niqra chotam. Umuttar leish latzet betabbaat sheyyesh aleha chotam zeh (im en derek hannashim lehitqashshet bah). Ubilbad shello yihyeh bolet bachotemet tzurat adam shelema, o shear tzurot haasurot apillu bechol, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman qm"a:

Dabar heasuy letakshit vegam lehishtammesh bo, kegon maptechot naot shel kesep kemin takshit, ap al pi shettelaan beshalshelet shebbetzavvaro o bachagorato o bishar meqomot shebbibgadayv kede lehitqashshet bahen bilbad — asur latzet bahen, mippene sheharoeh yomar shelletzorek tashmish hu motzian velo kede lehitqashshet bo kelal. Veyesh choleqin al zeh umattirin bemaptechot shel kesep, shekkevan sheen derek laasot maptechot shel kesep — hare iqqar asiyyatan mishshum takshit. Veap shemmishtammeshim bo gam ken, mikkol maqom kevan sheiqqaro letakshit asuy lo — eno nechshab lo kemassoy, umuttar latzet bo. Veken hamminhag bemiqtzat medinot ellu. Ubilbad sheyyehe beinyan sheen lachush bo shemma yipsoq veyippol laaretz veyishkach vibiennu beyado, vegam sheyyehe beinyan sheen haishsha yekola lesholpah mishsham leharotah lechabroteha, o sheenah tzerika lesholpah mishsham, sheyyekola leharoto beodo taluy sham, sheim lo ken ap leish asur latzet bah, kevan shehu takshit gam leishsha (veayyen simman sh"g sheakshav nahagu lehaqel betakshitin). Abal im hu shel barzel o shel nechoshet, ap al pi shettelao sham lenoy keen takshit — asur latzet bo, mittaam sheyyitbaer, veod shekkevan shedderek hu ken laasot hammapteach mibbarzel unechoshet — hare iqqaro naaset letashmish umassoy hu, veasur latzet bo, apillu im hu mechubbar veqabua leolam bachagora o bishar meqomot mibbegadayv, apillu hu qabua sham bechozeq kol kak ad shei epshar lahasiro mishsham leolam beli qilqul hammaqom shehu qabua bo, shekkevan shehu asuy letashmish bipne atzmo veeno meshammesh kelum leoto malbush shehu qabua bo — eno batel legabbe oto malbush, vahare zeh keillu hotzio bilbaddo beli oto malbush. Veap al pi shehammalbush chashub harbeh mimmennu — enennu tapel lammalbush bishbil kak, kevan sheenennu tzorek hammalbush velo tashmish hammalbush, vahare zeh keillu yotze betallit sheenah metzuyyetzet kehilkatah shechayyab chattat mittaam zeh, kemo sheyyitbaer. Umikkol maqom, im hu qabua berosh hachagora veasuy (keen zenqi"l lachagor bo — yesh mattirim, lepi sheaz hu meshammesh lehachagora ubatel etzlah, veap al pi sheeno qabua sham ella beshabbat bilbad). Veken nohagin bemiqtzat medinot ellu. Abal im hu qabua beemtza hachagora — en shum hetter baolam, ella im ken hu shel kesep, sheaz iqqaro naaset letakshit. Veken nedan shel kesep shergilin lehitqashshet bo — muttar latzet bo. Vehu shello yehe bah sakkin, veken tiq shel batte enayim (sheqqorin berili"n) ap shehu asuy mikkesep letakshit — asur latzet bo keshehabbatte enayim betoko, lepi sheen hassakkeyan vehabbatte enayim betelim legabbe hannedan vehattiq ap al pi shehem shel kesep, mippene shehassakkin vehabbatte enayim hem iqqar, shehare en omerim "naaseh sakkin lindan ubatte enayim letiq", ella "naaseh nedan lesakkin vetiq lebatte enayim":

Lo yetze hachayyat bemachat hattechuba lo bebigdo, apillu beotan meqomot sheen derek shear kol adam litchob bahem leolam veap hu eno tocheb sham ella lesimman sheyyakkirennu kol roehu shehu chayyat. Veken hannaggar shennoten qisam beozno lesimman, veken hassoreq shennoten meshicha[h] betzavvaro lesimman, veken kol shear umanim shennotenim dabar meumanatam lesimman — lo yetzeu bahem beshabbat. Veim yatzeu — peturin, sheen zo hotzaa kedarkah, kevan sheshshear kol adam enan motziin ken, veap haumanim en darkam lehotzi beinyan zeh ella beshaa sherotzim lehakriz al atzmam shehem umanim velo bishar peamim:

Lo yetze hazzab bekis sheoseh lehatztzilo mizzibato shello yetannep bah begadayv. Veim yatza — chayyab lehaomerim shemmelaka sheenah tzerika legupah chayyab aleha, abal lehaomerim shemmelaka sheenah tzerika legupah patur aleha kemo shennitbaer besimman ra"ch — ap zeh patur, lepi sheeno tzarik kelal legup hakkis shemmotzio, veen lo chepetz begupo ella sheyyatztzilennu mizzibato, abal mikkol maqom asur middibre soperim kishar melaka sheenah tzerika legupah. Veken ishsha nidda hamqashsheret beged lepaneha shello telaklek begadeha bedam niddotah — asura latzet bo, ella im ken hu sinar asuy keen malbush millepaneha umilleachareha, kemo miknasayim shellobeshim litzniut. Abal im hu milleachareha bilbad ella sheqqosharto birtzuot lepaneha — en zeh derek malbush, veasur. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmitkavvenet bebeged zeh lehatztzil mittinup bilbad, sheaz eno nechshab lemalbush ella im ken asuy keen malbush gamur, abal im mitkavvenet bo lehatztzil gupah mitztzaar, dehaynu shello yippol haddam al besarah veyityabbesh sham venimtza metzaarah — hare naasa beged zeh malbush gamur kishar malbushim shehem asuyim lahaganat haggup, umutteret latzet bo ap sheeno asuy keen malbush gamur:

Asur leishsha litten beged al tzeipah mippene haggeshamim shello yelakleku hatztzaip, shekkevan shemmitkavvenet bo lehatztzil mittinup — eno nechshab malbush. Abal im mitkavvenet shello yeredu haggeshamim al besara vitzaaruha — mutteret lipros beged al roshah ap al pi sheal yede zeh nitztzol hatztzaip gam ken mittinup. Veap keshemmitkavvenet bo lehatztzil mittinup bilbad, im eno munnach al roshah bilbad ella hi mitattepet bo gam ken rob gupah kederek malbush, veap al pi shehu beged ab vegas sheeno rauy lah velo hayeta mitattepet bo belo haggeshamim — mutteret latzet bo, apillu hu saq viria vachamila (perush mine begadim gassim), veken beish. Vekol shekken shemmuttar leish litten koba al gabbe koba sheal rosho mippene haggeshamim, kevan shehu derek malbush, ubilbad sheyyihyeh amoq al rosho, kemo sheyyitbaer:

En haqqittea shenniqteu raglayv yotze beqab shello, dehaynu sheoseh kemin depus shel regel vechoqeq bo meat lasum rosh shoqo betoko, veen oseh qab zeh kede lehallek bo, shehare al kol panim tzarik hu lemaqlo, umuttar lo latzet bemaqlo, kemo sheyyitbaer, hoil vehu tzorek hilluko, ella asiyyat qab zeh hu bishbil shello yehe nireh kachasar regel ella nekeh regel, lepikak kevan sheeno tzorek hilluko — (hare hu massoy) veasur latzet bo. (Veap shekkol dabar sheyyesh alayv torat malbush muttar lelobsho velatzet bo ap sheeno tzarik lelobsho letzorek halikato ella letzorek acher, veim ken hu haddin qab zeh shehu minal shello — lamma lo yetze bo ap al pi sheeno tzorek halikato ella lehitchappes bo shello yeraeh chasar regel? Lepi sheqqab zeh en alayv torat minal kelal, hoil vehu shel etz, veen niqra minal ella shel or, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman try"d. Veap im qab zeh mechuppeh or, sheaz yesh torat minal alayv, kemo sheyyitbaer sham — ap al pi ken lo yetze bo haqqittea, shekkevan sheen bo ella rosh shoqo — chosheshin shemma yishshamet mimmennu veyishkach vibiennu beyado, ella im ken or hachopeh et haqqab odep mimmennu gam ken lemala min haqqab beinyan sheyyukal lilbosh odep zeh al shoqo veliqshor sham alayv shello yukal lehishshamet mimmennu). Abal mi sheeno qittea — muttar lo latzet beminal shel etz (vaapillu eno mechuppeh or kelal, shekkevan sheharegel nikneset bo — en chosheshin shemma yishshamet meal raglo), ap al pi sheeno yakol lehaddeqo bechozeq sebib raglo. Vekol shekken shemmuttar latzet bemine minalim hammechuppim or sheqqorin (pantini"sh), ap al pi sheyyekolim lehishtammet meharaglayim bimhera, shekkevan sheharegel nikneset beor hachopeh — en chosheshin sheyyishshametu legamre. Veyesh meqomot shennohagin lehachamir shello latzet bahem lekattechilla, ap al pi shemmuttar min haddin. Abal im shakach veyatza bahem — eno tzarik lahasiram meal raglayv birshut harabbim:

Qittea bishte raglayv umehallek al arkubbotayv veal orek shoqayv veoseh lo samokot shel or o shel etz leorek shoqayv — muttar latzet bahem, lepi shehem takshit shello. Abal qittea sheyyabeshu vekavetzu gide shoqayv vearkubbotayv veeno yakol lehallek alehem kelal ella oseh lo kemin kisse namuk veyosheb alayv, ukeshehu mehallek nismak beyadayv al sapsalim qetannim veoqer gupo min haaretz venidchap lepanayv vechozer venach al achorayv vehakkisse qeshura lo meachorayv, veoseh lo samokot shel or o shel etz lerashe raglayv hatteluyim, shekkeshehu nishan al yadayv veoqer atzmo nishan gam al raglayv qetzat lipamim kesheyyesh lepanayv qarqa gaboah, abal rob peamim hen teluyin baavir veen nogein laaretz — lo yetze besamokot ellu beshabbat, shekkevan shehem teluyim veenam munnachim al haaretz — yesh lachush shemma yishshametu meal raglayv veyishkach vibiennu beyado. Abal bekisse shemmeachorayv ubassapsalim shebbeyadayv — muttar lo latzet, shekkevan sheeno yakol laleket mibbiladam — hare hem minalayv (shekkol gupo nismak alehem). Veken chigger sheeno yakol lelek kelal belo maqqel — muttar latzet bo apillu eno qashur lo. Abal im epshar lo lelek qetzat belo maqqel, veeno notelo ella lehachaziq et atzmo sheyyukal laleket (betob) yoter velo yippol. Veken zaqen haholek bebeto belo maqqel, ukesheyyotze lachutz nishan al maqlo mechamat teshush kocho — asur latzet bo beshabbat, apillu im hu zaqen kol kak shemmenaanea gupo umityare pen yippol (shekkevan sheholek bebeto belo maqqel, im ken en tzarik zeh lemaqqel sheyyismok alayv kol gupo vekol halikato, ella shemmitchazzeq bo beet shemmityare lippol — hare zeh kemassoy shennose letzorek halikato. Veeno domeh leminalim shekkol gupo nismak alehem bekol halikato, ulekak muttar latzet bahem ap im en alehem shem minal, kegon shel etz sheeno mechuppeh or). Veken choleh sheamad mecholyo. Im epshar lo lelek (qetzat) belo maqqel — asur latzet bo, veim lav — muttar. Veken suma lo yetze bemaqqel, shehare epshar lo lelek zulato, veeno notelo ella leyashsher uletaqqen pesiotayv. Veen tzarik lomar hachashubim shennohagim lelek bemaqqel chashub shebbeyadam, sheasurim latzet bo beshabbat. Vaapillu beyom tob asurim latzet bo (ayyen simman tqk"b):
Tob lizzaher shello latzet beshabbat kemo shehu yotze bechol bilti malbush o takshit echad, sheyyizkor al yado shehayyom shabbat velo yabo lechallelo:
Mi sheasur ukebalim beraglayv — muttar latzet bahem, mippene shehem lo kemo malbush, veen chosheshim shemma yippelu meal raglayv vibiem beyado, lepi shemmin hassetam hem tequim heteb shello yibrach:

En yotzein beanqatmin, vehu kemin chamor sheosim halletzanim venireh kerokeb alayv, vehu nose veholek beraglayv. Velo biqsharim, vehem etzim gebohim sheyyesh bahem moshab lekap haregel veholekin bahem betit. Velo beparmi, vehem keen tzurot partzup shennotenim al happanim lehapchid hattinoqot (shekkol ellu massoy hem, veenam malbushim vetakshitin). Veim yatza bahem — patur (sheen zo derek hotzaa lerob bene adam):

En yotzein beteba o quppa o machatzelet, vaapillu mippene haggeshamim, apillu shennitlabbesh bahem kemo bemalbush, shekkevan sheen derek lehitlabbesh bahem leolam — hare hen massoy. Abal yotzein besaq viria vachamila derek malbush, mippene shedderek latzet bahen bishat haggeshamim, velaken ap shello bishat haggeshamim shem malbush alehem:

Yotzein bepishtan saruq vetzemer menuppatz shennotenin al gabbe hammakka beshabbat kede shello yesaretu habbegadim et hammakka, mippene shehem lo kemo malbush. Ubilbad shehukenu mibbeod yom beinyan sheen bahem mishshum tiltul muqtzeh, al derek sheyyitbaer besimman sh"[ch]. Veken muttar likrok semartut al hammakka shebbeyado o shebbeetzbao velatzet bo lirshut harabbim (veen chosheshin lemarit haayin sheyyomru shemmitkavven lehotzi hassemartut velo bishbil hammakka kerako beyado):

Veen tzarik lomar shemmuttar latzet bispog vachatikot begadim daqqim yeshanim sheal hammakka shehen merappeim otah, vahare hen lo ketakshit, veken biqlippot shum ubatzal vaale gepanim ushear alim hamrappeim. Ubilbad shello yittenem al gabbe hammakka battechilla beshabbat, ap al pi sheeno rotzeh latzet bahem lirshut harabbim, lepi sheggazeru chakamim al kol dabar hamrappe shello litteno battechilla beshabbat, mishshum shello yabo lishchoq sammanim beshabbat, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shk"ch. Abal im haya aleha meereb shabbat venopla mealeha beshabbat, shemmuttar lehachazirah aleha kemo sheyyitbaer sham — muttar lehachazirah apillu birshut harabbim, kemo shemmuttar lehachazir lilbosh malbushim shennapelu mealayv birshut harabbim. Veken retiyya vekayyotze bah shennopla mimmakkatah velo higgia laaretz, ella nopla al gabbe keli, shemmuttar lehachaziran al gabbe makkato kemo sheyyitbaer sham — muttar lehachaziran apillu birshut harabbim:

Muttar leegod semartut al haretiyya o al shear debarim sheal hammakka velatzet bo lirshut harabbim, veyakol lehattiro birshut harabbim velachazor uleqoshro sham, veen chosheshim keshemmattiro beyado birshut harabbim shemma yishkach vibiennu beyado, mittaam sheyyitbaer besimman sh"g. Abal asur likrok chut o meshicha al gabbe haretiyya o shear debarim sheal hammakka, lepi shehachut o meshicha chashubim qetzat veenam betelim legabbe retiyya kemo iggud shel semartut sheeno chashub kelal, shekkeshemmattiro meharetiyya sheeno tzarik lo od hare hu mashliko laaretz, ulepikak hu batel legabbe haretiyya:

Habbanim yotzein bezaggin shel zahab haarugim o tepurim lahem biksutam lenoy, abal im enam arugim o tepurim ella teluyin al yede qesher vekayyotze bazeh — asurim latzet bahem ap al pi shehem banim qetannim, lepi sheen derek latzet bezaggin ella bene melakim vekayyotze bahem mibbene ashirim gedolim, velishar banim hare hu yuhara, ubene melakim vehaashirim mesachaqim alehem al shemmityaharim bedabar sheenan reuyin lahem, veyesh lachush shemma yishma abiv shel zeh haholek bezaggin shemmesachaqim alayv veyelek veyasir hazzaggin mibbeno, kevan sheenan arugin velo tepurim, veyishkach vibiennu beyado birshut harabbim. Vaapillu keshehem arugim biksutam — lo yeleku bahem apillu babbayit ella kesheen bahem inbal, abal im yesh bahem inbal heasuy lehashmia qol — asurim lelobsham beshabbat, sheasur lehashmia qol shel zug heasuy leqashqesh bo hattinoq, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shl"ch veshal"t. Veap al pi shekkan oseh zot haqqatan veen anu metzuvvim lehaprish haqqatan mechillul shabbat, mikkol maqom asur litten lo malbush zeh shehazzug arug bo, shehare zeh kemaakilo issur beyadayim, ayyen simman shm"g. Abal kesheen bo inbal — muttar ap legadol latzet biksuto shehazzug arug o tapur bo. Veim hu mibbene melakim o kayyotze bahem, ap im taluy betzavvaro — muttar latzet bo. Veen chosheshin shemma yipsoq veyippol vibiennu beyado, lepi shemmin hassetam kol zug shel kesep o zahab toqein oto yapeh beshalshelet shello yipsoq. Abal zug shel shear mine matteket — en kol adam rashshay latzet bo ad sheyyihyeh arug o tapur biksuto, sheap sheen lachush bo shemma yischaqu alayv bene melakim vekayyotze bahem, kevan sheen zeh chashub kelal veen bo yuhara, shedderek kol adam latzet bo, mikkol maqom yesh lachush shemma yipsoq veyippol vibiennu beyado:

Vekol zeh bezug shehaya derek bimehem laasoto lenoy lekol habbegadim, shel bene melakim vekayyotze bahem mikkesep vezahab, ushear kol adam mishshear mine mattekot, ulekak lo ratzu chakamim lehatriach leposqo meereb shabbat mikkol habbegadim shehu arug o tapur bahem ulegannot habbegadim. Abal takshit sheen regilin lechabbero bebeged — asur latzet bo ap al pi shearug vetapur bebeged, sheggazeru alayv gezera mishshum eno arug vetapur, kevan sheen sham genay kelal im yapsiqennu mehabbeged, shehare en regilut kelal lechabbero bebeged. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bishar mine matteket, abal shel kesep o zahab — muttar bekol inyan, vaapillu litloto betzavvaro, shekkevan shemmin hassetam toqein oto yapeh shello yippol veyipsoq mechamat sheddamayv yeqarim — en ligzor bo shemmo lo yechabberennu yapeh beinyan sheyyukal lippaseq velippol. Velaken hittiru latzet bemapteach shel zahab o kesep hatteluyim bebigdo, ap al pi sheen regilut litloto sham, veaseru bemapteach shel shear mine mattekot, kemo shennitbaer lemala, lebad mittaam hamboar sham:

Vekol zeh betakshit, shehu dabar hammuttar latzet bo, veen tzarik sheyyihyeh mechubbar liksut ella mishshum gezera shemma yippaseq veyippol, abal im chibber liksuto dabar sheeno asuy letakshit ella lehishtammesh bo, shehu dabar haasur latzet bo — en chibburo liksut mattiro latzet bo, vahare hu ketalush umupsaq mehakkesut, dekevan shehu asuy lehishtammesh bipne atzmo, veeno meshammesh kelum leoto malbush, shehu eno batel legabbe oto malbush ap al pi shehammalbush chashub harbeh mimmennu, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheddabar zeh shechibbero liksut hu chashub qetzat neged hakkesut, abal im eno chashub kelal neged chashibut hakkesut, kegon mitpachat shemmeqannechin bo et haap (sheqqorin patzeli"sh) — hare hi betela legabbe hakkesut im hi tepura lo beb' tekipot, sheb' tekipot chashubin chibbur leinyan kilayim (uleinyan shabbat, ayyen simman sh"m). Abal im hi tepura lachagora — asur latzet bo, shenneged hachagora hi chashuba veenah betela eleha. Veen tzarik lomar im qeshura sham apillu beqesher shel qayyama. Veap im rotzeh lachagor sham bemitpachat zo al gabbe hachagora o tachteha — en zeh moil kelum, sheen yotzein beb' chagorot zo al gabbe zo, kemo sheyyitbaer. Umi sherotzeh lissa immo mitpachat zo — en lo taqqana ella im ken yiqsherenna berosh hachagora (meereb shabbat) beqesher shel qayyama, sheaz naaset kachagora achat arukka, veyachgor et atzmo bekullah kol zeman sheholek barechob. Veken asur latzet bematlit sheqqosherin biptilin shel koba leqanneach bah enayv, mippene sheenah betela legabbe hakkoba:

Otan iggulim yeruqqim sheggozra malkut shekkol yehudi yissa echad mehem biksuto — muttar latzet bahem beshabbat, shehem betelim legabbe hakkesut, ap im enam tepurim biksut ella mechubbarim bah qetzat al yede qeshira vekayyotze bah:

Muttar latzet bemine asabim sheqqosherin otam biqsharim vetolin otam betzavvar lirpua, veenam kemassoy leadam ella ketakshit, hoil vehem lirpua. Umittaam zeh muttar latzet beqamea mumcheh, shettakshit hu lecholeh keechad mimmalbushayv. Abal en yotzein beqamea sheeno mumcheh apillu lekarmelit. Veezehu qamea mumcheh? Kol sheasahu ish mumcheh ap al pi shehaqqamea atzmah eno mumcheh, vekol shekken im qamea atzmo hu mumcheh ap al pi sheasahu ish sheeno mumcheh. Ketzad naaseh haish mumcheh? Kegon shekkatab lachash echad beg' iggerot, verippe g' bene adam, kol iggeret rippata adam echad — naasa ish hakkoteb mumcheh lelachash zeh. Vekol paam sheyyiktebennu muttar latzet bo beshabbat ap al pi shehaqqamea atzmo eno mumcheh, sheiggeret zo had' lo rippata adayin meolam. Veap shehaish eno yodea kelum birpuot — en bekak kelum. Veim adam acher katab iggeret zo harebiit, ap al pi shehu oto lachash atzmo shebbeiggerot harishonot — asur latzet, hoil velo ketabah ish hammumcheh, shemmazzalo gorem. Veap haish hammumcheh lo naasa mumcheh al yede ken ella lelachash zeh bilbad abal lo lishar lechashim, veap im katab kamma mine lechashim vekol echad mehem hoilu kamma peamim — lo naasa mumcheh ella lilchashim ellu shehoilu g' peamim, abal lo lishar lechashim shello hoilu adayin g' peamim:

Veketzad naaseh haqqamea atzmo mumcheh ap al pi shello asao ish mumcheh? Kegon shekkatab lachash echad beiggeret achat, verippata oto iggeret g' peamim, shennaasa zo haiggeret mumcheh. Umuttar lekol adam latzet bah beshabbat ap al pi shehaish eno mumcheh adayin, shello katab ella qamea achat. Veim yiktob od lachash zeh beiggeret acheret — asur latzet beotah iggeret beshabbat kol zeman shello rippata g' peamim:

En haish naaseh mumcheh ad sheyyerappeu g' iggerotayv leg' bene adam, kol iggeret leadam echad, abal im rippe leadam echad kamma peamim bekamma iggerot shel lachash echad — lo naasa mumcheh lelachash zeh, sheyyesh maqom litlot harepua bemazzalo shel hacholeh, shemmazzalo gorem lo sheyyeqabbel repuato miqqameot, abal keshekkoteb lachash zeh leadam acher — epshar shello yoil lo kelum veasur latzet bo. (Veap adam zeh shennitrappe kebar g' peamim — asur latzet beiggeret acher shel ish zeh, shello naasah adayin mumcheh lekol adam):

Abal im iggeret achat rippata g' peamim apillu leadam echad — naaset qamea zo mumcheh lekol adam, shekkol adam muttar latzet bah beshabbat, shemmin hassetam yesh litlot harepua beqamea hammumcheh velo bemazzal hacholeh, mah sheen ken kesheg' iggerot rippeu adam echad, sheaz lo naaset shum achat mehen qamea mumcheh, veal ken tzarik litlot harepua bemazzal adam, o bemazzal harope hakkoteb iggerot, o bemazzal hacholeh shemmeqabbel harepua mehaiggerot — azay lo naasa harope mumcheh al yede kak, ki shemma mazzal hacholeh gorem, ella im ken rippe leg' bene adam, sheaz min hassetam harepua teluya bemazzalo, kevan shehuchzaq beg' anashim:

Veim harope ibbed et hamchaato millachash zeh, kegon sheachar sherippe g' bene adam belachash echad katab od g' iggerot millachash zeh leg' bene adam velo hoilu kelum — mikkan veelak asur latzet beiggerotayv sheyyiktob od, o apillu beiggerot shekkatab kebar beodo mumcheh. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beiggerot shello rippeu ella paam o shettayim, abal iggeret sherippata kebar g' peamim, kevan shennaaset qamea mumcheh mitztzad atzmah — muttar lekol adam latzet bah leolam, ap leachar sheibbed harope shekketabah et hamchaato. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennaaset iggeret zo qamea mumcheh qodem shennaasa harope mumcheh, o apillu im bau b' hammechaot keechad, kegon shekkatab b' iggerot leb' bene adam, kol achat mehem rippea leadam echad mehen lebaddo paam o shettayim, bilbad veachar kak katab iggeret shelishit leechad mehem verippea oto adam b' peamim, veaz adayin lo naasa harope mumcheh, kevan shello huchzaq adayin beg' anashim, veken iggeret zo hashshelishit enah qamea mumcheh adayin, kevan shello rippea ella b' peamim, veachar kak rippea iggeret zo hashshelishit paam g' leadam acher — naasa rope shekketabah mumcheh lelachash zeh, kevan shehuchzaq beg' anashim, vegam iggeret zo hashshelishit naaset qamea mumcheh leolam, ap leachar sheyyobad harope hamchaato. Abal im naasa harope mumcheh qodem shennaaset iggeret zo qamea mumcheh, dehaynu sherippe kebar g' anashim beg' iggerot qodem sherippe iggeret zo paam g', ap im iggeret zo hi mishshene iggerot shennitchazzeq bahen harope lemumcheh — asur latzet bah achar sheibbed harope hamchaato, ki shemma en iggeret zo qamea mumcheh mitztzad atzmo, umah sherippea paam g' hu mechamat shekketabah rope shennitbarer lanu kebar hamchaato al yede sherippe kebar g' peamim beg' iggerot, veim ken leachar sheibbed harope hamchaato — shemma obda gam ken hamchaat iggeret zo:

Kol qamea mumcheh shemmuttar latzet bah — en chilluq ben im hu shel ketab ben im hu shel iqqarin, ben im hu choleh sheyyesh bo sakkana ben sheen bo sakkana, vaapillu im lo achazo adayin shum choli kelal, ella shehu mimmishpachat nikpin vekayyotze bahen mishshear hacholaim vedoeg shello yochazennu choli mishpachto vetoleh bo qamea — muttar latzet bo (beshabbat lirshut harabbim). Veqamea shel ketab sheyyesh bo azkarot o pesuqim mikkitbe haqqodesh, im hu mechuppeh or shemmuttar likkanes bo lebet hakkisse — muttar latzet bo beshabbat lirshut harabbim. Veim eno mechuppeh or — asur latzet bo beshabbat, gezera shemma yitztarek lebet hakkisse visirennu mealayv beyado veyishkach vibiennu beyado birshut harabbim. Veim hu choleh sheyyesh bo sakkana im yesirennu mealayv apillu lepi shaa — hare muttar lo likkanes lebet hakkisse mippene piqquach nepesh, velaken muttar lo gam ken latzet bo lirshut harabbim:

Lo yiqshor haqqamea beetzada o betabbaat veyetze bo lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit, mippene marit haayin, shennireh keillu mitqashshet bo betorat takshit veeno mitkavven kelal lirpua, ubeemet eno takshit kelal ella mechamat harepua. Abal keshehu qashur vetaluy betzavvaro — yakol lehattiro birshut harabbim im eno qesher shel qayyama, velachazor uleqoshro, veen chosheshin keshemmattiro beyado birshut harabbim shemma yishkach vibiennu beyado, mittaam sheyyitbaer besimman sh"g:

Neeman harope lomar al atzmo shehu mumcheh leqameot shekkebar rippe g' anashim beg' iggerot, veken neeman lomar al qamea achat sherippe veshana veshillesh, venaasa qamea mumcheh, ap al pi shehu eno mumcheh adayin:

Muttar latzet bebetzat hechagab sheshshemo chargol shettolin oto beozno likeb haozen, ubeshen shel shual chay shettolin lemi sheyyashen yoter midday sheyyaqitz mishshenato, ubeshen shel shual met shettolin lemi sheeno yakol lishan sheyyishan, ubemasmer meetz shetztzalebu alayv shemmerappeim bo nepach shel makkat barzel (ap al pi shekkol ellu repuatan bisgulla — muttar latzet bahen ben bechol ben beshabbat). Veen bezeh mishshum darke haemori, kevan shennikkar haddabar shemmitkavven lirpua. Veken bekol dabar sheoseh venikkar bo shemmitkavven lirpua, ap al pi sheen yadua lanu heak baa harepua al yede asiyyat dabar zeh. Abal im oseh ezeh maaseh veen nikkar bo shehu mishshum repua — asur mishshum darke haemori, shehizhira hattora alehen "velo teleku bechuqqot haggoy vego'". Abal kol lachash muttar lirpua, o lehagen shello yabo alayv choli o nezeq, apillu im en yadua im lachash zeh moil o lav. Abal im yadua shellachash zeh eno moil — asur mishshum darke haemori. Veyesh mi shechoshesh bekol lachash sheeno baduq ubekol qamea sheenah mumcheh mishshum darke haemori. Vekol baal nepesh yachush lidbarayv (bemaqom sheen sham tzorek kol kak):

Kol mi sheyyesh lo beraglo makka sherpuato liqshor aleha matbea sheyyesh alayv tzura — muttar latzet bo, shekkevan shehu merappe — hare hu lo ketakshit (umalbush). Abal im hu makka sheen hammatbea merappe otah, veenah qeshura aleha ella lehagen alayv shello tingop beqotzim veyitdot hadderakim — asur latzet bah, shehammatbea chashub hu, veeno mitbattel mechashibuto lehiqqare alayv shem malbush (vetakshit), ella im ken yesh bo tzorek lirpua (sheaz yesh alayv shem takshit):

Hayyotze betallit hamquppelet umunnachat al ketepayv, dehaynu shelleachar shennetanah al rosho higbiah shule[ha] al ketepayv, ben shehigbiah kol orek shuleha, ben shello higbiah ella shene kanpe shuleha, venatan kanap echad al katep zeh vekanap echad al katep zeh veemtzait shuleha meshulshelet al gupo lematta mikketepayv — chayyab, sheen zeh derek malbush, ella massoy hu. Veyesh poterin kesheemtzait shuleha meshulshelet lematta mikketepayv, ap al pi shekkenapeha netunim al ketepayv. Veken iqqar. Abal asur middibre soperim, mippene shennireh kemassoy. Vaapillu im en kenapeha netunim al ketepayv, ella shettepasam beyadayv vehigbiah kede shello yitlaklek o kede shello yiqqara — asur. Abal im eno magbiah beyadayv, ella hu mitattep betallito beinyan sheshshuleha mugbahin harbeh min haaretz, vekanpe shuleha enam netunim al ketepayv, ella hem meshulshalim al zeroe yadayv, veemtzait shuleha meshulshelet lematta mikketepayv umekassa rob gupo — hare zeh muttar. Ulepi zeh muttar lehitattep betallit tachat haggelima lahabio lebet hakkeneset beshabbat shacharit, sheap shemmitattep bah beinyan shemmitqatztzeret sheenah yotza mittachat haggelima lematta, kol shehu mekasseh rob gupo — muttar:

Lo aseru litten kanpe shuleha apillu al ketepayv ella keshemmitkavven lehagbiah hattallit shello telaklek beshuleha, o shello tiqqara, o shello teakkebehu millaleket bimhera, abal im kavvanato lehitnaot bezeh, keminhag anshe hammaqom shemmitnaim bezeh gam bechol — hare zeh muttar shezzehu derek lebishatam, veeno nireh kemassoy. Veen tzarik lomar shemmuttar leqappel qatzvot shule tallito mikkan umikkan al yadayv kede lehitnaot, ubilbad sheemtzait shuleha meshulshelet lematta mikketepayv umekassa rob gupo. Vekol zeh betallit shehi chatika achat merubbaat kemo tallitot shel mitzva shellanu, sheen bahem neqabim lehotzi hayyadayim mittokam, abal malbushim shellanu shehu labush bahem umotzi et hayyadayim mittokam — muttar litpos beyadayim miqtzat hammalbush apillu beshulayv lehagbiah shello yeakkebuhu millaleket, o shello yitlaklek, o shello yiqqara. Abal lo yagbiah harbeh kol orek shuleha beinyan shello yehe rob gupo mekusseh, velo yihyu derek malbush kelal, veap im emtzait shulayv mekasseh rob gupo — lo yagbiah qatzvot shulayv al ketepayv, kevan shelleyesh omerim sheyyesh bezeh chiyyub chattat, uledibre hakkol al kol panim nireh kemassoy veasur middibre soperim, veap shellabush bo umotzi yadayv mittoko. Umalbushim shellanu shennitattep bahen velo hotzi yadayv mittokam — asur litpos qetzatam beyadayv lehagbiham shello yitlaklek, apillu eno topes beshulehem:

Bimqomot shennahagu leqappel hattallit ulehannichah kak mequppelet al kitpehem sebib tzavvaram veholekin kak ap bachatzerot ubebattehem — muttarim latzet ken beshabbat ap lirshut harabbim, shedderek mallebbush hu lahem. Abal im en holekin ken bebattehem, ella kesheyyotzein lachutz meqappelin hattallit al kitpehem tachat haggelima lahabiah lebet hakkeneset — asur latzet ken beshabbat, veim yatza — chayyab, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Umikkol maqom, muttar leqappel tzad hayyamin ulehannichah al katep semol kederek shemmitattepin betalitot shel mitzva velatzet ken lirshut harabbim, hoil vekak hu derek lebishatah ap babbayit. Veken yotze adam besudar hamquppal umunnach al ketepo, hoil vekak hu derek lebishato, veeno tzarik likrok nima min hassudar al etzbao shello yippol mealayv. Abal bimqomot sheen kak derek lebishato, kegon bimdinot ellu, im rotzeh lehotzi sudar — tzarik lekassot bo rosho verubbo derek malbush gamur. Veim en hassudar rachab kol kak lekassot rosho verubbo — yesh lo taqqana laasoto kemin abnet velatzet bo, dehaynu sheyyiqshor b' rashe hassudar (shemmillepanayv) zeh bezeh (kenegdo) lematta mikketepayv (vegam emtzaut hassudar shemmilleacharayv yehe mashuk lematta mikketepayv), shennimtza asuy kemin abnet, umuttar latzet bo (ap shechagur beabnet acher lematta, lehammattirim latzet beb' chagorot, kemo sheyyitbaer). Veyesh mi sheomer sheap bimqomot shedderek lebishatam hu besudar hamquppal al kitpehem — tzarik sheyyehe hassudar rachab lekassot rosho verubbo im yapshituhu miqqippulo, veim eno rachab kol kak — en shem malbush alayv, veen yotzein bo, ella im ken asao kemin abnet, kemo shennitbaer. Veyesh lahem lachush lidbarayv:

Hayyotze bemaot hatztzerurim lo bisdino shehu labush bo — chayyab, ap al pi sheeno ochazem beyado, lepi shedderek lehotzi ken bechol lipamim. Abal hayyotze bemaot hattepurim bebigdo — patur, sheen derek hotzaa bekak, abal asur latzet bo middibre soperim, ben shettepurim bo maot ben kesep vezahab sheenam muqtzim. Ubimqom hepsed, kegon shehu ben hannokrim shei epshar lo lehapqidam etzlam, vegam lo lehanniach habbeged bebetam shello yignebuha mimmennu kesheyyetze hachutza — nohagin lehaqel latzet bahem, lepi sheyyesh omerim shekkol shebut shehu shinnuy midderek hachol lo gazeru alayv bimqom hepsed merubbeh, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"z, vegam yesh omerim sheakshav en lanu reshut harabbim ella karmelit, vaapillu hotzaa kedarkah enah asura bah ella middibre soperim. Umikkol maqom, en lehaqel ella keshei epshar lo shello latzet lekarmelit, kegon shemmityare lesheb kalu babbayit kol hayyom, shello yargishu hannokrim sheyyesh etzlo maot veyachpesu kelayv legozlam mimmennu, o epshar sheyyabo lide sakkana sheyyaharguhu bishbil meotayv. Abal im epshar lo shello latzet, kegon shehu ben yisreelim ella sheeno maaminam lehapqidam etzlam o lehanniach habbeged bebetam — yesheb babbayit kol hashshabbat, velo yetze bahem lekarmelit. Veim en chashash lehapqid etzlam, o sheen chashash lehanniach habbeged babbayit — yesh lehachamir leposhto mealayv mibbeod yom, shello yehe labush bo beshabbat apillu babbayit, shemma yishkach veyetze bo, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"g:

Vekol zeh bitpurim bebigdo, sheen zo hotzaa kedarkah, abal im hem tzerurim bo, o shehem bekis hattapur bo shedderek lehotzi bo bechol, o shehen beezor chalul shedderek lehotzi bo kesheppiv lemala, o shehen ben begadayv libsaro bimqomot shedderek lehotzi ken bechol lipamim — asur latzet bahem apillu lekarmelit, ap al pi shemmityare lesheb immahem babbayit shello yargishu bo hannokrim. Vaapillu letaltel hammaot lehatzniam beezeh maqom beotah chatzer — asur, shello hittiru shum shebut gamur mishshum hepsed merubbeh. Vaapillu im hem maot menuqqabim sheen yotzein behotzaa beshippuy — lo mapqa shem muqtzeh mehem, ella im ken hem shel kesep veshel zahab unequbim kede litlot betzavvar bitto letakshit (sheaz muttar letaltelan ap shello bimqom chashash hepsed kelal im hem meyuchadim lekak). Umikkol maqom, muttar lo laset hammaot etzlo beoto chatzer, lepi shezzehu tiltul kilachar yad, kevan sheeno metaltelan beyado ella begupo, ubilbad sheyyesh chashash hepsed im lo yissaum etzlo, sheim lo ken ap im enam maot hammuqtzim ella shear kesep vezahab — yesh lehachamir shello laset otam etzlo, shemma yishkach veyetze bahem, kemo shennitbaer:

Vekol zeh keshehahepsed hu ba beinyan sheen nibhal kol kak bishbilo, veeno nechpaz kol kak mechamato lehatztzalat mamono, kegon zeh sheshshobet ben hannokrim shemmityare shello yigzelu mimmennu meotayv, sheeno bahul kol kak kesheen mattirim lo latzet bahem mibbetam, kevan sheadayin en shum adam ba ligzol mimmennu. Abal mi shellistim baim alayv ligzol mamono, o sheabde hammoshel baim lechappes betebato laqachat mamono, shehu bahul venechpaz lehatztzil mehem — yesh mattirim letaltel meotayv beyado lehachbiam bemachaboot. Veim en lo machabo beoto chatzer — yesh mattirin apillu lehotzi lemaqom acher derek karmelit, lepi sheen adam maamid atzmo al mamono ubevadday yatztzilem mehepsed, veim lo nattir lo lehatztzil al yede tiltul muqtzeh vetiltul hakkarmelit shehen middibre soperim — yesh lachush shello yabo lide issur shel tora behatztzalatam, sheyyachpirem baqqarqa vekayyotze bazeh (shekkevan shehu bahul venechpaz behatztzalatam — yemaher lehatztzilo bekol hatztzala shettizdammen lo yoter bimhera, ki omer belibbo haek sheeeseh lo eeseh behetter, mah sheen ken keshehittiru lo chakamim lehatztzil al yede issur shel dibrehem — lo yatztzil al yede issur shel tora). Uleinyan halaka — en lehaqel ella beissur tiltul muqtzeh, abal lo beissur hakkarmelit, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shl"d:

Lebadim haqqashim harbeh — asur lehotziam lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit keshehu meuttap bahem derek malbush, lepi sheenam reuyim lemalbush venirim kemassoy. Abal im enam qashim harbeh — muttar, apillu eno tzarik kelal lehitattep bahem, veen mitattep bahem ella kede lehotziam lirshut harabbim lesheb alehem sham hu o acher, ubilbad sheyyitattep bahem rosho verubbo, abal im lo kissa bahem rosho ella kol gupo bilbad — lo naasu malbush al yede ken, veasur lehotziam apillu im tzarik lahem lehitkassot bahem gupo. Veken haddin bekol dabar sheeno malbush verotzeh lehotzio al yede sheyyitattep bo kederek malbush, kegon sadin o sudar bimdinot ellu, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Muttar latzet lirshut harabbim bishne malbushim hashshavim zeh al gabbe zeh ap al pi sheeno tzarik ella leechad mehem veeno motzi hashsheni ella letzorek chabero, veen hashsheni nireh kemassoy hoil vehu labush bo. Vaapillu mine malbushim sheen derek leolam lehitlabbesh bishnayim letzorek atzmo, kegon shette chagorot zo al gabbe zo — en hashsheniyya chashuba massoy, hoil vehu chagur bah. Veyesh choleqin bezeh veoserin shette chagorot, shekkevan shello beatzmo en shum hanaa vetoelet lilbishato mehachagora hashsheniyya veeno motziah ella letzorek chabero — hare hu massoy. Veken rauy linhog. Veap im eno motzio letzorek chabero, ella shechoger chagora chashuba al gabbe chagora qarua — asur, shekkevan shebbehachashuba bilbadda day lo letzorek lebishato — hare hashsheniyya chashub massoy, ap al pi shehu chagur bah, kevan sheen derek lachagor ken. Abal bimqomot shedderek lachagor b' chagorot — muttar latzet bahen. Ubekol maqom muttar latzet bb' chagorot kesheyyesh malbush mapsiq benehem, kegon hattachtona al gabbe hechaluq vehaelyona al gabbe hassarbal, sheaz yesh hanaa vetoelet mishtehen. Veken bekol inyan sheyyesh lo beatzmo hanaa vetoelet lilbishato mishte hachagorot. Veap im akshav eno tzarik hu ella leachat mehen umotzi hashsheniyya letzorek chabero, hoil vechagur beinyan shedderek lachagor bah lipamim letzorek atzmo — enah massoy umuttar:

Vekol zeh bachagora, abal bishar malbushim, apillu otam sherob happeamim en derek lehitlabbesh bishnayim hashshavim letzorek atzmo, kegon shene chaluqim zeh al gabbe zeh, o shene sarbilim zeh al gabbe zeh, o b' anpelaot zo al gabbe zo, hoil ubimot haqqor derek hu lipamim lehitlabbesh bishnayim ushelosha malbushim o yoter — hare hem chashubim derek malbush kol hashshana umuttar lehotziam apillu letzorek chabero. Veken muttar latzet bishne kobaim (apillu letzorek chabero, lepi) shekken darko bechol lasum koba gadol al gabbe koba qatan, ubilbad sheyyehe beinyan shello yukal haruach lehapriach koba haelyon meal rosho, kemo sheyyitbaer:

Bebatte yadayim (sheqqorin hentashi"ke) — muttar latzet, lepi shehem malbush shel hayyadayim. Veyesh mi shemmachmir lehatzrik sheyyitperum meereb shabbat bebatte yadayim shel malbushayv (o sheyyiqsherem bahem qesher shel qayyama yapeh), lepi shellipamim tzarik lemashmesh bibsaro mippene kinna o parosh haoqetzim oto, veeno yakol lemashmesh beyadayim hallebushim bebatte yadayim, vetzarik lehotzi yad echad mibbet yad echad veochez habbet yad beyado hashsheniyya shello kederek malbush, shemma yishkach vibienna kak d' ammot. Verauy lachush lidbarayv. Abal beoto bet yad shellanu shemmesimin bo shette hayyadayim achat mippoh veachat mippoh — muttar latzet bo beli shum qeshira utepira, lepi sheap im yotzi mimmennu yado echad kede lemashmesh bah beezeh maqom — yishshaer adayin labush al yado hashsheniyya, veen kan issur kelal im yelek kak d' ammot, veen chosheshin shemma yotzi mimmennu shette yadayv veachar kak yishkach veyochazennu beyado veyelek bo d' ammot. Veyesh machmirin gam bezeh (vetob lachush ledibrehem bemaqom sheepshar, sheen haqqor gadol kol kak). Abal hamminhag lehaqel (bekol inyan):

Muttar latzet betallit hamtzuyyetzet kehilkatah, apillu ballayla sheeno zeman tzitzit, sheen hatztzitzit hakkesherot chashubin massoy, ella hare hen minnoy habbeged umittakshitayv, kemo haimra vekayyotze bah. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beish, abal beishsha sheyyatzata betallit hamtzuyyetzet — chayyebet, shemmassoy hu lah zo. Veim enah metzuyyetzet kehilkatah — hare hen massoy ap leish, velo yetze bah, veim yatza — chayyab chattat, mippene sheotan hachutin chashubin hen beenayv vedato alehem ad sheyyashlimem veyaasem tzitzit, ulepikak enam betelim legabbe hattallit ap al pi shehem qeshurim bo qesher shel qayyama:

Abal muttar latzet meuttap bekilla shetteluyin bah retzuot shemmoshekin otah bahen al gabbe kelonas sheal gabbe hammitta, ap al pi sheharetzuot enan tzerikin kelal lakkilla keshemmitattep veyotze bah, mikkol maqom kevan sheenan chashubin kelal — hare hen betelin legabbe hakkilla. Lepikak, muttar latzet birtzuot hatteluyot baabnet, sheenan chashubot, ubetelot legabbe haabnet. Abal im hen shel meshi — hare hen chashubot veenan betelot, veasur latzet bahen, ella im ken hamminalim o habbatte shoqayim qeshurin bahem, sheaz hen meshammeshot lilbishato veenan massoy:

Veken haddin bekol dabar shennipsaq min habbeged verosho echad mechubbar labbeged, kegon lulaot vekayyotze bahen, im hu chashub — asur latzet bo, shekkevan sheeno meshammeshet kelum labbeged mechamat shennipsaq rosho echad — hare hu massoy, veeno batel legabbe habbeged, kevan shehu chashub vedato alayv. Abal im eno chashub — hare hu batel legabbe habbeged, umuttar latzet bo:

Koba gadol shemmesimin al harosh kede laasot tzel al happanim lehagen mippene hachamma, o kede lehagen mippene hazzebubim, vekol kayyotze bazeh shehu mitkavven bilbishato sheyyaahil alayv lehagen meezeh dabar — asur lelobsho beshabbat apillu betok habbayit, mishshum issur asiyyat ohel, im hu mitpashshet lehallan merosho tepach al tepach (vaapillu hu keneged panayv bilbad). Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehattepach hammitpashshet (hazzeh) hu qasheh vechazaq sheeno nikpap lematta, abal im nikpap lematta, ap im bolet harbeh yoter mittepach sebibot kol rosho — en shem ohel alayv umuttar. Lepikak, muttar lipros hattallit al rosho ap al pi shebbolet harbeh lehallan merosho, ella im ken hu mimmin beged haqqasheh (sheqqorin gera"b geri"n). Veyesh omerim shello aseru ella keshehu qasheh beyoter keen gag (shei epshar lo beqal lihyot nikpap, laken yesh alayv shem ohel, abal im eno qasheh beyoter — en shem ohel alayv umuttar). Veyesh mi shemmeqel od sheim eno omed beshaveh ella beshippua — en shem ohel alayv, umuttar ap shehu qasheh beyoter. Vetob lehachamir (bekol zeh sheyyehe nikpap mammash lematta meelayv, veaz ap im magbiho umaamido beshaveh beyado — en bekak kelum). Vekol zeh keshemmitkavven bo lehaahil alayv lehagen meezeh dabar, abal im eno mitkavven raq lekassot rosho, ap al pi shemmimmela naaseh ohel sebibo — en bekak kelum, lepi shekkol ohel sheen lo depanot tachtayv — en issur baasiyyato ella im ken mitkavven bo laasiyyat ohel, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sht"v:

Lepikak, muttar lilbosh koba gadol shel lebed hannahug biqtzat meqomot sheqqorin (beriti"l) ap im yesh betoko neyar qasheh sheal yede ken mitqashsheh beyoter veomed beshaveh, kevan sheeno mitkavven leohel ella lekassot rosho. Ubimqomot shennahagu lehaqel bekol inyan ap im hu mitkavven leohel — en limchot beyadam, ki yesh lahem al mah sheyyismeku, sheyyesh mattirin legamre bekol inyan, shessoberim shello gazeru kan mishshum asiyyat ohel, hoil venaaseh derek lebisha:

Vekol zeh lilbosh hakkoba babbayit, abal asur lilbosh al gabbe koba qatan sheal rosho velatzet bo, ap al pi sheeno mitpashshet tepach lehallan merosho, lepi sheyyesh lachush shemma yaprichennu haruach meal rosho veyishkach vibiennu beyado d' ammot, ella im ken hu mehuddaq berosho, o shehu amoq sherosho niknas letoko veen haruach yakol lehapricho merosho, o shehu qashur birtzua tachat gerono, shebbezeh en lachush liklum. Ubimqomot sheen derek bene adam lelek barechob bekoba qatan bilbad beli koba zeh haggadol — muttar latzet bo bekol inyan, shebbevadday lo yelek d' ammot bilado. Abal im yesh alayv koba shedderek lelek bo barechob lipamim — asur lilbosh alayv shum koba acher, ben gadol ben qatan, ap al pi shehu tzarik lo mechamat haqqor vekayyotze bazeh, ella im ken hu beinyan sheen lachush bo shemma yappilennu haruach meal rosho, kemo shennitbaer:

Mi shemmatza tepillin beshabbat birshut harabbim o bassadeh o bekol maqom sheenan mishtammerim mikkelabim vekayyotze bahem vikolin labo lide bizzayon ketzad yaaseh? Im yesh bahem retzuot qeshurot sheyyakol lelobshan — yaknisen lair zug zug, dehaynu sheyyalbishen kedarkan bechol, tepillin shel yad al zeroo veshel rosh al rosho, veniknas vecholetzan bair (bechatzer hachitzona shehu maqom hammishtammer roshon), vechozer veyotze velobesh zug acher ad sheyyaknis kullan. Veeno yakol lilbosh b' zugot keachat, ap al pi shello yaabor bezeh be"bal tosip", shehare shabbat eno zeman tepillin kelal, ukeshemmosip al hammitzva shello bizmannah lo shayyak "bal tosip" kelal, mikkol maqom kevan shebbechol en lobesh leolam b' zugot, im ken zug hashsheni eno niqra derek lebisha ella kemassoy hu, velo hittiru chakamim mishshum bizyon hattepillin ella zug echad, shehu kederek lebisha bechol veeno nireh kemassoy, veen issuro shello bimqom bizzayon ella mishshum gezera shemma yebiennu beyado, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Veim hayu zugot harbeh beinyan shello yaspiq hayyom lehaknis kullan zug zug derek lebisha, kevan sheyyitztarek lehaknis gam mishshettechshak — lo yaknisen kelal beyom, ella yesheb kan leshomran ad shettechshak, veaz yaknis kullan beyadayv. Vekol zeh beish, abal ishsha shemmotza tepillin, apillu hen zug echad — tesheb vetishmeren ad hallayla, velo taknisen lair derek malbush, shekkevan sheen hannashim mannichot tepillin bechol — enan malbush lahen ella massoy gamur. Veim mityare lesheb kan ad shettechshak mippene listim shodede layla — yittol kullan beyadayv miyyad veyoliken pachot pachot mid' ammot, kederek shennitbaer besimman rs"v, ad shemmaggia lechatzer hachitzona, o noten kullan lachabero sheetzlo betok d' ammot, vachabero lachabero sheetzlo, ad sheyyaggiu lechatzer hachitzona shel ir, shehu maqom hammishtammer harishon, ukesheyyaggia lipne hechatzer hahu yoshit otan lachabero haomed bechatzer, vachabero yittelen miyyado beshaa shehu holek, shennimtza hu oseh aqira mereshut harabbim, vachabero oseh hannacha birshut hayyachid. O yaknisu otan zug zug derek lebisha, im yesh shahut bayyom lehaknis kullan. Abal lo yizreqem lechatzer kilachar yad kemo shennitbaer besimman rs"v, mippene bizyon hattepillin, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman rp"b:

Veim hu bime haggezera sheggazeru shello lehaniach hattepillin sheyyesh bo sakkana apillu lesheb alehen leshomran vekol shekken lahabian beyadayv sheyyomru shehu meniach tepillin mekassan bimqoman veholek lo ben shehem harbeh ben shehem meat:

Veken im matza seper tora bassadeh bime haggezera sheggazeru shella lelomdo — mekassehu bimqomo veholek lo. Veim eno zeman haggezera — tzarik lesheb uleshomro ad shettechshak, veaz yebiennu lebeto. Veim hayu haggeshamim yoredim shemmitqalqel hasseper im yihyeh kan ad hallayla — yitattep behasseper keen malbush, vechozer umekasseh alayv bibgadayv, umebio lebeto miyyad, sheap sheeno derek malbush gamur — hittiru lo mippene kebod hattora:
Habba lehatztzil kelayv mippene haddeleqa, haek yotziem derek reshut harabbim — yitbaer besimman shl"d:

Hamlabben et hatztzemer o et happishtan veken kol kayyotze bahen mimmah sheddarkan lehitlabben — chayyab, vehu meabot melakot, shekken bammishkan hayu melabbenim hatztzemer vehappishtim haasuyim limlakot hammishkan. Vehamkabbes begadim — hare hu toledet melabben vechayyab. Vehassochet et habbeged ad sheyyotzi hammayim shebbo — hare zeh kimkabbes begadim, vechayyab mishshum melabben. Lepikak, asur lelek beshabbat bemaqom sheyyakol lehachaliq velippol bemayim, shemma yishsharu begadayv bemayim veyishkach veyischot. Veim halak venapal venishru begadayv bemayim, veken mi shennishru begadayv bigshamim harbeh sheyyaredu alehem — eno tzarik leposhtan miyyad, ella yakol lehallek bahen (kol hayyom), veen chosheshin shemma yishkach veyischatem behilluko (bahem). Abal lo yenaarem min hammayim, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"b. Ukeshepposhetan mealayv — lo yishtachem lenaggebam beshabbat, mippene marit haayin, sheharoeh otam shetuchim lenaggeb yomar shekkibbesan beshabbat. Vaapillu leshotcham becheder sheen sham roeh — asur, shekkol dabar sheaseru chakamim mippene marit haayin shello yachsheduhu sheasa issur shel tora — asur apillu bechadre chadarim, mippene sheyyesh lachush shemma yeera paam achat sheyyabo echad pitom lesham veyirehu veyachshedehu sheabar al dibre tora, lepikak lo ratzu lechalleq bigzeratam veaseru bekol inyan, ap im hu beinyan sheen lachush lekak:

Velo aseru ella leshotcham beshabbat, abal im hayu shetuchim meereb shabbat — eno chayyab lesalleqan beshabbat mippene marit haayin. Abal lishtoach beshabbat aseru bekol inyan, apillu lo nishru bemayim ella min hazzea:

Beged hashsharuy bemayim, apillu en sham ella sheriyya muetet — asur lenaggebo samuk leesh, ap al pi sheeno shotecho sham, ella menaggebo sham keshehu labush bo, sheen kan marit haayin — ap al pi ken asur mishshum bishshul, shehammayim habbeluim mitbashshelim sham, im hu samuk laesh kol kak ad shehabbeged yakol lehitchammem sham kol kak ad shehayyad soledet bo. Abal im eno samuk kol kak — muttar lenaggebo sham kol sheeno shotecho:

Beged hashsharuy bemayim — asur letaltelo leachar sheppeshato mealayv, shemma yishkach veyischatennu, ella im ken hu beged sheeno maqpid al memayv veap bechol lo haya sochato, o sheen bo ella sheriyya muetet sheen derek lehaqpid aleha lesochotah. Veim nishru beshekar o beyayin adom o bishar mashqin sheenam melabbenim — muttar letaltelo ap al pi shennishru harbeh. Veap lekattechilla muttar lehashroto bahem, kegon lesannenam alayv, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shy"t vesh"k:

Harochetz panayv yadayv veraglayv bechammin shehuchammu meereb shabbat, o apillu kol gupo bechamme teberya o betzonen — hittiru lo lehistappeg bemitpachat o besadin vekayyotze bahen, ap al pi shemmaqpid al memehem lesochotam bahem bechol — lo chasheshu shemma yishkach veyischatem beshabbat, lepi shezzehu dabar shei epshar ligzor alayv, shekkevan shekkol harochatzin mistappegin, im atta osero lehistappeg — ap atta osero birchitza, vezehu dabar shei epshar, sheppaam achat gazeru shello lirchotz mippene habballanim shehayu mechammin chammin beshabbat veameru meereb shabbat huchammu, veachar kak rau sheen haddabar omed vechazeru vehittiru. Umuttar lo gam ken lehabi hammitpachat beyado mibbet hammerchatz lebeto im yesh sham erub, veen chosheshin shemma yishkach veyischatennu bahalikato (sheim nachush lekak veneesor lo lahabio — hare anu oserim lehistappeg, shei epshar lo lehapqiro ulehannicho bebet hammerchatz). Veasur lo lemosro lehabballan, mippene shehabballanim chashudim al hassechita lischot beyadayim. Veap akshav bizman hazzeh sheepshar laamod belo rechitza beshabbat veim ken epshar lemono millehistappeg — ap al pi ken en issur baddabar, meachar shello neesar meolam beminyan chakamim. Umikkol maqom, tob lehistappeg bedabar sheeno maqpid al memayv lesochoto ap bechol:

Muttar laamod al sepat hannahar velirchotz yadayv bannahar, veen bezeh issur bemah shemmotzi hammayim sheal yadayv min hannahar el sepato, lepi shehannahar hu karmelit usepat hannahar hu gam ken karmelit, umuttar lehotzi mikkarmelit lekarmelit bepachot mid' ammot, raq sheyyizzaher lenaggeb yadayv yapeh miyyad shehotziam mehannahar qodem sheyyelek d' ammot. Veken harochetz bannahar — tzarik lenaggeb gupo yapeh kesheoleh mehannahar, shello yishshaaru alayv mayim vitaltelennu d' ammot bekarmelit. Abal haholek birshut harabbim umatar sochep alayv veal lebusho — lo hiqpidu chakamim al zeh, lepi shehu dabar shei epshar laamod alayv, shellipamim adam holek birshut harabbim upitom yarad haggeshem alayv, laken hittiru lo bekol inyan (ap latzet mibbeto bishat haggeshem, sheen leesor dabar lachatzain):

Baale haqqorcha shemmannichin al rashehem pishtan saruq o tzemer menuppatz sheyyehe nireh kesear berashehem — muttarim lehannicho berashehen beshabbat velatzet bo lirshut harabbim, shettakshit shellahem hu, ubilbad shehukenu mibbeud yom beinyan sheen bo issur mishshum tiltul muqtzeh, veal derek sheyyitbaer besimman sh"ch:
